7. **No containerization, Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, or observability tooling.** She meets none of the preferred qualifications either.

8. **No mentoring or technical leadership experience.** The role requires mentoring junior/mid-level engineers; no such experience is indicated.

9. **Years of experience are in analytics, not engineering.** Despite six years of experience, none of it is in software engineering, making her effectively a career-changer relative to this role.
